description: This file contains unit tests for key-value type classes in the WPEFramework project, using the Google Test framework. It tests the behavior of KeyValueType and TextKeyValueType classes, including comparison, assignment, and key/value access.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: Template class representing a key-value pair with comparison and accessor methods.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Class representing a textual fragment, used as a key or value in key-value types.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: Template class representing a text-based key-value pair with case sensitivity options.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for KeyValueType instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for KeyValueType instances.

methods.name: Key()
methods.description: Returns the key string within KeyValueType.

methods.name: Value()
methods.description: Returns the value string within KeyValueType.

methods.name: IsKey()
methods.description: Checks if the provided string matches the key.
